$comment: Expectations drafted with `pnpm packs:truth` and reviewed by hand on 2026-10-14, before the pack was scored. The truth helper links @sentry/react outside the consumer, so React's types do not resolve from it and Sentry.ErrorBoundary reports TS2607/TS2786 in both repositories; a real scripts-off install of the target (youth-activity-scheduler, recorded in ../sentry/RESEARCH.md) leaves only the two sendDefaultPii errors, and neither upgrade touched ErrorBoundary. Those diagnostics are helper artifacts, not expectations. Entries from flimm on were drafted and reviewed the same way on 2026-10-16 (UPT-64), before the pack was scored with them; the same ErrorBoundary artifacts appear there and are left out the same way.
